name: ttb-published-san-pasqual-valley-EPSG4269
note: Feature 1 is TTB's San Pasqual Valley feature exactly as served (geometry and attributes unaltered). Features 2 and 3 were added by the commenter to mark the shared out-and-back line and the excluded hillock, using TTB's own vertices.

properties.part: Shared boundary line (traversed out and back)
properties.cfr_text: follows the Escondido Corporate Boundary line to the 500-foot contour line on the hillock and circumnavigates said hillock back to the Escondido Corporate Boundary line (27 CFR 9.25(c)(2))
properties.derived: vertices of the TTB polygon that coincide within 3 m with vertices traversed in the opposite direction
loop of the TTB polygon beyond the shared line; all test points inside it fall outside the AVA polygon
